description.value: This study compared grey matter volumes of college-aged binge drinkers and healthy volunteers using voxel-based morphometry, focusing on the ventral striatum, hippocampus and amygdala, with additional analyses of AUDIT-score associations.

spans.text: To address this, we compared the grey matter volumes of college-age binge drinkers and healthy controls, focusing on the ventral striatum, hippocampus and amygdala.

description.value: T1-weighted images were reoriented, segmented into cerebrospinal fluid, white matter, and grey matter with SPM8 New Segment, and total intracranial volume was estimated from summed tissue-class volumes. DARTEL generated a sample-specific template for nonlinear deformation; images were normalized to ICBM 152 MNI space and smoothed with a 10 mm FWHM isotropic Gaussian kernel. The pipeline produced grey matter concentration images for voxel-based morphometry.
